issue_context.title: kubectl --local is not quite local across all the commands
issue_context.body:
This situation was discovered when I wanted to remove deprecated functionality in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/90243. Unfortunately, due to how we are constructing client in almost every kubectl command this removal ended up with the following bug https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/90074.

The reason for that is that in each command's `Complete` method we create a client in one of the following ways:
```go
o.Client, err = batchv1client.NewForConfig(clientConfig)
if err != nil {
	return err
}
```
```go
dynamicClient, err := f.DynamicClient()
if err != nil {
	return err
}
```
```go
discoveryClient, err := f.ToDiscoveryClient()
if err != nil {
	return err
}
```
The problem is that with the deprecated code from #90243 removed all of the above calls will fail when creating a client with:
```
error: Missing or incomplete configuration info.  Please point to an existing, complete config file:

  1. Via the command-line flag --kubeconfig
  2. Via the KUBECONFIG environment variable
  3. In your home directory as ~/.kube/config
```
which does not happen if we silently default the server to `http://localhost:8080` in deprecated `getDefaultServer`. 

There are two possible approaches to this problem:
1. Go through each and every single command and add conditions for `--local` flag and not to create clients when it is specified.
2. Provide a smart mechanism allowing to inject dependencies (in this particular case, we are talking about clients).

During SIG-CLI call on July 15th, we agreed that solution 1 is a short-term and rather hacky approach to the problem and we would like to see this being approached as described in no. 2. 

Any proposals to this should be discussed with @soltysh or during one of sig-cli calls.

@soltysh I have a PoC here https://github.com/knight42/kubernetes/commit/016cb482ad75df7a0e5d59d48ac85809ad555af1.

In summary, I move the flag `--local` to `genericclioptions.ConfigFlags`, i.e. `--local` becomes a global flag, and make `genericclioptions.clientConfig` return empty configs if `--local` is set to true.

@knight42 I really like that PoC for local and how closed it is, I think we should go with that

@SaiHarshaK wrt to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/94744 it's not quite solving the local problem, but I like how you're approaching the problem of code duplication we have across all of the commands. @aubm was also interested in minimazing code duplication (he did a small POC in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/91226 for create commands). I think the two could figure out a bigger fix, which would allow us to limit the code duplication. I'm guessing we'd need to identify the minimal common set of flags we currently set across all or at least let's say 80% of commands and see if that can be combined in some CommonOptions structure.

I've stumbled upon this issue while I'm trying to remove `getDefaultServer` [function](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/641fd5b482c6117d459a22d99f76aae086c3524f/staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/tools/clientcmd/client_config.go#L54) which was already deprecated(due to totally unrelated bug).

As far as I understand, if we handle `--local` and `--dry-run=client` cases, we can safely remove this function. I looked for a smart solution as stated in description(no. 2), but factory, which already does the nearly all api server requests, is interface and does not take any parameters.

Nothing comes to my mind being smart but also backwards compatible. Maybe we can apply first option safely.

@soltysh what do you think?

review_comments: Although this solves the problem, that's not the right approach. See what I wrote in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/93188, towards the bottom. You picked the hacky solution which we don't want to happen. The entire sig including the tech leads would like to see a more general solution, rather this one off.
